message: The other day, my friend Susan was in a tizzy over the forecast of severe storms. She always jumps to the worst-case scenario, bless her heart. I reminded her that we’ve lived through plenty of storms—albeit with a few extra snacks on hand and a cozy blanket to ride it out. Sometimes, a little calm prep goes a long way in keeping the panic at bay. What’s your go-to comfort during a storm? 🌧️
